title: thlaspi griffithianum
intro: Thlaspi griffithianum, commonly known as Griffith's whitlow grass, is a species of flowering plant in the family Brassicaceae. This plant is known for its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of T. griffithianum include the inhibition of pro-inflammatory enzymes, which may help to reduce pain and inflammation. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, terpenoids, and other phenolic compounds, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
